answer: Pay agents for what the network would lose without them. At dawn each epoch, the ledger replays the day's outputs with one agent removed at a time and pays each by that leave-one-out gap. A lotus of fifty clones blooming from one model looks lush, but pluck any petal and nothing is missed, since its siblings said the same thing, so each earns almost nothing. A lone agent with a distinct answer leaves a real hollow when removed, and gets paid for it. Splitting yourself only divides the same value.
